## About
Reseda Transmissions is a locally owned and operated auto repair shop serving the San Fernando Valley. Owner Raul Hernandez got into transmission work with one goal: to be the most trustworthy and dependable transmission shop in the Valley.
We diagnose, rebuild and maintain transmissions, and we also work on differentials. Our technicians ask the right questions, walk you through your options and put together a few proposals. Then you decide what makes sense for your car and your budget. No high pressure.
We're rated 4.6 from 37 Google reviews.

## Services
- Transmission repair: Maintenance, troubleshooting and repairs for automatics and manuals, from classic cars to newer models.
- Diagnostics: Trouble code scans, electrical testing and inspections to find out what's really going on.
- Rebuilt transmissions: Rebuilt rear wheel drive and front wheel drive transmissions, with removal and installation.
- ATF and filter service: ATF and filter service to help keep your transmission shifting smoothly.
- Transmissions and differentials: We sell transmissions and differentials, and carry parts like valve bodies, solenoid packs, filters, gaskets and torque converters.

## FAQ
Q: Do you work on imported cars?
A: Yes. We work on both domestic and imported vehicles.

Q: Do rebuilt transmissions come with warranties?
A: Yes. Our rebuilt transmissions come standard with one-year or 12,000 mile warranties, whichever comes first.

Q: Are extended warranties available?
A: Yes. We also offer extended two-year or 24,000 mile warranties and three-year or 36,000 mile warranties.
